articles.title: Vinci Compass (VINP) Turns Deal-Making Into Its Growth Engine
articles.summary: On August 11, Vinci Compass Investments Ltd. (NASDAQ:VINP) posted its second quarter 2026 results and used the same announcement to unveil its next acquisiti...
articles.body:
On August 11, Vinci Compass Investments Ltd. (NASDAQ: VINP ) posted its second quarter 2026 results and used the same announcement to unveil its next acquisition target, continuing a pattern of building scale through deals across Latin America's alternative asset industry. The Rio de Janeiro-based firm paired steady fee growth with a move into Brazil's real estate fund market, giving investors two storylines to weigh at once. Here is what the numbers and the deal actually tell you.

Vinci Compass generated R$88.7 million in fee-related earnings during the quarter, up 36% from a year earlier, translating to R$1.35 per common share. That kind of jump in recurring fee income, rather than one-time performance fees, points to a client base that keeps adding assets to the platform. The company backed that up with R$13 billion in capital formation and appreciation for the quarter, a sign that money is still flowing in even as markets stay choppy. Adjusted distributable earnings came in at R$63.3 million, or R$0.96 per share, giving shareholders a cash-based measure that supports the quarterly dividend of $0.17 per share set for holders of record as of August 25.

On top of the organic growth, Vinci Compass closed its combination with BACS Asset Management in Argentina during the quarter, followed by an agreement to acquire Navi's Real Estate platform, which carried roughly R$800 million in assets under management before the deal officially closed ahead of schedule on September 1. That portfolio includes four REITs traded on the Brazilian exchange and CETIP, concentrated in multi-strategy and residential real estate funds with long lock-up structures. Layering a real estate specialist onto an already diversified alternatives shop gives Vinci Compass another distribution channel for capital it is already raising, and CEO Alessandro Horta framed the deal as part of a broader push to consolidate high-quality platforms across the region.

Now that the Navi transaction has crossed the finish line, attention shifts entirely to execution. Folding a specialized real estate manager into a firm that already spans credit, real estate, and an Argentine asset manager through BACS adds immediate operational complexity, requiring different systems, teams, and client relationships to mesh seamlessly under one roof.

Fee-related earnings growth of 36% also sets a higher bar for future quarters, since a slowdown from that pace could read as deceleration even if the underlying business stays healthy. Investors have relatively little independent data yet on how the BACS integration is progressing, since the deal only just closed, so the near-term execution risk sits mostly with management's ability to bring two more organizations under one roof at the same time.

articles.title: Precio de la luz por horas hoy, jueves 10 de septiembre: cuándo es más barata y más cara
articles.standfirst: La electricidad se encarece: jueves con subida notable
articles.summary: La electricidad se encarece: jueves con subida notable
articles.body: El precio medio de la electricidad hoy, jueves, se sitúa en 145,22 €/MWh, lo que representa un aumento de 37,46 € respecto a los 107,76 €/MWh del día anterior. Esta notable subida marca una tendencia al alza en la tarifa eléctrica. A medida que avanza la jornada, se prevé un análisis de las horas más caras y más baratas para optimizar el consumo de energía. La luz es más cara durante las horas punta, específicamente entre las 19:00 y las 22:00, donde se registran los precios más elevados. En este intervalo, la tarifa alcanza su máximo a las 20:00 con un precio de 271.53 €/MWh, seguido de horas igualmente costosas como las 21:00 y 22:00, con 254.72 €/MWh y 225.29 €/MWh, respectivamente. Además, se observa un bloque continuado de tarifas altas desde las 18:00 hasta las 22:00, lo que justifica la necesidad de planificar el consumo eléctrico en estos tramos horarios para evitar costes elevados. La luz es más barata entre las 10:00 y las 16:00, con una ventana amplia de precios bajos que ofrece importantes oportunidades de ahorro. Las franjas horarias más relevantes son 10:00 - 11:00 con un precio de 83.42 €/MWh, 11:00 - 12:00 a 14.9 €/MWh, 12:00 - 13:00 a 7.26 €/MWh y 13:00 - 14:00 a 10.52 €/MWh. Esto demuestra que durante esta franja, los precios son notablemente más bajos en comparación con otras horas del día. En esta jornada, se observa una notable concentración de precios elevados durante las horas centrales del día, particularmente entre las 19:00 y las 21:00, donde las tarifas superan los 250 €/MWh. Este fenómeno es relevante para el consumidor, ya que indica momentos críticos en los que el gasto en electricidad puede incrementarse considerablemente y resalta la importancia de planificar su consumo para evitar tarifas excesivas.

articles.title: Índia vai pressionar por criação de moeda digital do BRICS apesar de obstáculos, diz agência | G1
articles.standfirst: País não pretende substituir pagamentos em dólar. Assunto está na agenda da reunião de líderes do BRICS, no entanto, desafios políticos e operacionais podem limitar avanço da proposta.
articles.summary: País não pretende substituir pagamentos em dólar. Assunto está na agenda da reunião de líderes do BRICS, no entanto, desafios políticos e operacionais podem limitar avanço da proposta.
articles.body:
Cédula simbólica dos Brics apresentada em Fórum Econômico de São Petersburgo. — Foto: Reprodução/Redes sociais

A Índia deve pressionar pela integração das moedas digitais emitidas pelos bancos centrais dos países do BRICS para facilitar pagamentos internacionais durante uma cúpula do grupo nesta semana. País vai apoiar proposta apesar de obstáculos políticos e técnicos que podem limitar seu avanço, disseram duas fontes que preferiram anonimato.

A Índia preside o BRICS neste ano. Os líderes do grupo se reunirão em Nova Delhi nos dias 12 e 13 de setembro. O Reserve Bank of India (RBI), o banco central indiano, propôs em janeiro a integração das moedas digitais oficiais dos países para facilitar o comércio internacional , informou a Reuters.

O BRICS reúne Brasil, Rússia, Índia, China e África do Sul, além de Egito, Etiópia, Indonésia, Irã, Arábia Saudita e Emirados Árabes Unidos.

A proposta de integração das moedas digitais dos bancos centrais fará parte da agenda da reunião de líderes, disseram as fontes. A baixa adoção dessas moedas digitais em todo o mundo, no entanto, pode dificultar sua implementação .

As fontes não quiseram ser identificadas devido à sensibilidade do tema e porque não estão autorizadas a falar com a imprensa.

Os ministérios indianos das Relações Exteriores e das Finanças e o banco central do país não responderam aos pedidos de comentário enviados por e-mail.

A proposta da Índia dará continuidade à declaração aprovada na cúpula do BRICS de 2025, no Rio de Janeiro, que defendeu a interoperabilidade entre os sistemas de pagamento dos países-membros para tornar as transações internacionais mais eficientes.

Qualquer avanço na integração das moedas digitais dos bancos centrais, porém, deve enfrentar desafios significativos. Discussões anteriores dentro do BRICS sobre a criação de mecanismos de pagamento compartilhados avançaram pouco, evidenciando as dificuldades de integrar infraestruturas financeiras de países com sistemas e interesses diversos.

As relações tensas entre alguns países, como Irã e Emirados Árabes Unidos, continuarão sendo um obstáculo, disse uma das fontes. Os Emirados Árabes Unidos cortaram relações financeiras com o Irã, segundo ela.

A Índia também tem demonstrado resistência em aprofundar a integração financeira com a China , afirmou a segunda fonte. Segundo ela, acordos desse tipo exigiriam um nível maior de confiança entre os dois países .

A Índia barrou uma proposta da Alipay+ para se conectar ao sistema indiano de pagamentos instantâneos em transações internacionais por questões de segurança nacional relacionadas aos vínculos da empresa com a China, informou a Reuters.

Também seriam necessários acordos de swap cambial para ajudar a administrar desequilíbrios comerciais antes que a integração das moedas digitais pudesse entrar em operação, acrescentou a fonte.

Os países do BRICS já estudaram alternativas aos pagamentos baseados no dólar. Entre elas estava uma proposta do Brasil para a criação de uma moeda comum para o grupo, mas o plano não avançou.

O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, já havia alertado o bloco contra uma iniciativa desse tipo e ameaçado impor tarifas elevadas.

A Índia não tem interesse em substituir o dólar, afirmou a segunda fonte. Segundo ela, o objetivo da integração das moedas digitais oficiais é tornar os pagamentos internacionais mais fáceis e rápidos.

articles.title: Dólar abre em alta, com inflação dos EUA no radar | G1
articles.standfirst: Na véspera, a moeda americana subiu 0,51%, sendo cotada a R$ 5,1116. Já a bolsa brasileira caiu 0,93%, aos 185.629 pontos.
articles.summary: Na véspera, a moeda americana subiu 0,51%, sendo cotada a R$ 5,1116. Já a bolsa brasileira caiu 0,93%, aos 185.629 pontos.
articles.body:
O dólar abriu a sessão desta quinta-feira (10) em alta, com um avanço de 0,14% perto das 9h, cotado a R$ 5,1189 . Já as negociações do Ibovespa , principal índice da bolsa brasileira, começam às 10h.

▶️ O principal destaque da sessão fica por conta dos novos dados da inflação ao produtor dos Estados Unidos . Com divulgação prevista para hoje, o indicador deve ser fundamental para a decisão de juros do Federal Reserve ( Fed , o banco central americano) na próxima semana.

▶️ Ainda no exterior, as tensões no Oriente Médio seguem no radar. Na véspera, o petróleo voltou a ultrapassar os US$ 100 pela primeira vez desde 24 de julho , após o exército americano destruir cinco petroleiros iranianos em retaliação a uma tentativa de ataque a um navio de guerra dos EUA.

A piora do conflito continua a levantar preocupações com a oferta global de petróleo. PErto das 9h, o barril do Brent , referência internacional, subia 0,79% , cotado a US$ 102,01 . Já o West Texas Intermediate ( WTI ), referência nos EUA, avançava 1,17% , a US$ 97,17 o barril.

▶️ No Brasil, o mercado continua a acompanhar as decisões do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) sobre investigações relacionadas ao Banco Master. Na véspera, o ministro do STF, Flavio Dino, determinou a reintegração imediata de Andrei Rodrigues ao cargo de diretor-geral da Polícia Federal (PF) e de Leandro Almada da Costa à chefia da Diretoria de Inteligência Policial da corporação. Entenda.

▶️ Na agenda econômica, o foco fica com a nova Pesquisa Mensal de Serviços (PMS). A expectativa é que o indicador mostre uma ala de 0,2% no setor na comparação mensal e de 0,1% na relação anual. O mercado também avalia as novas medidas tributárias e de subvenção anunciadas pelo governo para os combustíveis.

Veja abaixo mais detalhes do dia no mercado.

O petróleo voltou a superar os US$ 100 nesta quarta-feira (9), em meio à escalada das tensões no Oriente Médio. É a primeira vez em mais de um mês que a commodity atinge esse patamar.

A alta dos preços da commodity no mercado internacional acompanha o aumento das preocupações com o fluxo de petróleo no Oriente Médio. O conflito entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã já dura seis meses.

Nesta semana, ataques dos Houthis, grupo apoiado pelo Irã, atingiram instalações de energia na Arábia Saudita e provocaram incêndios em estruturas ligadas à produção de petróleo.

Os ataques dos Houthis podem ameaçar os embarques de petróleo pelo Mar Vermelho, que se tornou uma importante rota alternativa ao Estreito de Ormuz. Antes da guerra, cerca de 20% do comércio mundial de petróleo passava pelo estreito, cujo fluxo foi severamente reduzido desde o início do conflito.

Após os ataques, um porta-voz militar dos Houthis afirmou que o grupo anunciará uma ampla operação em território saudita, sinalizando uma nova escalada da guerra.

Além disso, na véspera, vários navios petroleiros iranianos ligados à Guarda Revolucionária foram atacados pelos Estados Unidos. Segundo autoridades americanas, a ofensiva foi uma retaliação a uma tentativa do Irã de atingir um navio da Marinha do país.

O aumento das tensões volta a levantar preocupações sobre a oferta global da commodity, com vários bancos já elevado suas projeções para o preço do petróleo no mercado internacional.

Caso essa estimativa se confirme, a expectativa é que a alta do petróleo provoque novos aumentos nos custos de energia e pressione a inflação global. Isso poderia levar bancos centrais de diversos países a manter ou elevar as taxas de juros.

O ministro Flávio Dino, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), determinou nesta quarta-feira (9) a imediata reintegração de Andrei Rodrigues ao cargo de diretor-geral da Polícia Federal (PF) e de Leandro Almada da Costa à chefia da Diretoria de Inteligência Policial da corporação.

A decisão atende a um pedido formulado por Andrei Rodrigues dentro de um processo que já estava tramitando no STF e ocorre um dia depois de o ministro André Mendonça determinar o afastamento dos servidores .

O magistrado determinou ainda que os dois oficiais fiquem protegidos contra novas medidas cautelares motivadas pelo regular cumprimento de ordens judiciais.

Dino é relator de um inquérito que investiga o repasse de emendas parlamentares federais a uma produtora responsável por produzir a cinebiografia do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, o filme "Dark Horse".

O ministro do STF disse que já havia autorizado a Polícia Federal a acessar a íntegra dos materiais apreendidos pela Polícia Civil de São Paulo em uma investigação sobre emendas parlamentares destinadas a empresas supostamente responsáveis pela produção do filme.

Ao acolher o pedido, o relator ponderou que o afastamento determinado por André Mendonça prejudica diretamente o andamento dessa e de outras apurações urgentes sob sua relatoria.

🔎 Andrei Rodrigues sustentou ao Supremo que a sua saída do cargo de diretor-geral interfere na organização da equipe responsável pelas investigações, retarda o acesso ao material disponibilizado e compromete a atuação célere da corporação.

Dino também ressaltou que a decisão de Mendonça foi tomada a partir de um pedido do Partido Novo, o que considerou juridicamente inviável. Veja mais detalhes aqui.

A decisão volta a jogar luz no cenário político, uma vez que Mendonça está no centro de uma disputa com o ministro do STF Alexandre de Moraes no âmbito do inquérito do Banco Master. Moraes, por sua vez, é um dos principais alvos de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) na disputa eleitoral com Lula (PT).

Na Ásia , a maioria dos índices fechou em queda, à medida que a escalada das tensões no Oriente Médio reacenderam preocupações os preços do petróleo e a inflação global.

O SSEC , índice de Xangai, perdeu 0,43%, enquanto o CSI300 , que reúne as maiores empresas das bolsas de Xangai e Shenzhen, caiu 0,53%. Já o Hang Seng, de Hong Kong , caiu 1,27%.

Entre os demais mercados da região, o índice Nikkei , do Japão, subiu 0,20%, enquanto o Kospi , da Coreia do Sul, desvalorizou 0,25%.

* Com informações da agência de notícias Reuters.

articles.title: Conflito no Oriente Médio pode encarecer produtos, diz CEO da Nestlé | G1
articles.standfirst: Alta nos custos de energia, frete e matérias-primas afeta fornecedores e pode levar a novos reajustes; Nestlé também reformula produtos e corta itens menos procurados.
articles.summary: Alta nos custos de energia, frete e matérias-primas afeta fornecedores e pode levar a novos reajustes; Nestlé também reformula produtos e corta itens menos procurados.
articles.body:
A Nestlé está aumentando preços, reformulando produtos e retirando itens pelos quais os consumidores não estão dispostos a pagar mais, diante da alta dos custos de energia, frete e matérias-primas provocada pelos efeitos do conflito no Oriente Médio, afirmou à Reuters o presidente-executivo da companhia, Philipp Navratil.

Segundo o executivo , a guerra entre Estados Unidos e Israel contra o Irã , que já dura seis meses, teve pouco impacto direto sobre as vendas da Nestlé na região. O efeito maior, porém, aparece nos custos dos fornecedores, que podem ser repassados para os produtos.

“Todos os nossos fornecedores terão algum aumento de custos”, disse Navratil. “Alguns desses custos virão até nós e teremos que mitigá-los, garantindo que os consumidores acompanhem caso tenhamos que aumentar preços.”

A Nestlé é dona de marcas como Nescafé, Maggi e KitKat e tem mais de 2 mil marcas em seu portfólio.

De acordo com o CEO, o conflito aumenta os custos dos insumos utilizados pela indústria de alimentos. A empresa afirma que está buscando maneiras de reduzir despesas para evitar que toda a alta seja repassada aos consumidores.

Além de reajustar preços, a Nestlé está reformulando produtos e procurando reduzir custos. A companhia também pretende eliminar produtos pelos quais os consumidores não estejam dispostos a pagar mais, segundo Navratil.

O executivo não informou quais produtos podem deixar de ser vendidos.

“Mas haverá efeitos primários em termos de inflação no que compramos, em termos de custos de insumos”, afirmou.

O Oriente Médio representa entre 2% e 3% do faturamento total da Nestlé , que gira em torno de 90 bilhões de francos suíços (US$ 111 bilhões). Por isso, segundo Navratil, o impacto direto da guerra sobre as vendas da companhia é limitado.

A pressão sobre os custos ocorre em um momento de alta nos preços internacionais de alimentos.

A Organização das Nações Unidas para a Alimentação e a Agricultura (FAO) alertou que o mundo pode estar caminhando para um novo período de inflação de alimentos.

💰 O Índice de Preços de Alimentos da FAO, que acompanha as variações mensais de uma cesta de produtos alimentícios comercializados internacionalmente, ficou em 131,1 pontos em julho, acima dos 130,3 pontos registrados em junho. Foi o maior nível do indicador desde janeiro de 2023.

A estratégia de redução de custos faz parte de uma revisão mais ampla do portfólio da Nestlé .

A companhia vendeu recentemente uma participação em seu negócio de água engarrafada e também está deixando o segmento de vitaminas.

Navratil, que recebeu a missão de concentrar a empresa em suas principais marcas, afirmou, porém, que a Nestlé continua aberta a fazer aquisições.

“Isso não significa que a Nestlé esteja apenas se desfazendo de ativos. Como sempre, estamos abertos a adquirir empresas que sejam estrategicamente importantes”, disse.

O executivo não deu detalhes sobre possíveis aquisições.

Empresa defende participação em discussão sobre rótulos na Índia

Em outro assunto, Navratil afirmou que fabricantes de alimentos deveriam participar das discussões sobre uma proposta para incluir advertências sobre açúcar, sal e gordura na parte frontal das embalagens na Índia.

A Reuters informou em agosto que empresas estavam fazendo lobby contra os avisos, segundo documentos e registros analisados pela agência.

Navratil afirmou que a Nestlé já retirou milhares de toneladas de açúcar, sal e gordura de seus produtos, mas defendeu que a rotulagem seja feita de maneira adequada e leve em conta o tamanho das porções.

articles.title: JHC propõe criar 'Territórios da Paz' e uma nova macrorregião de saúde | G1
articles.standfirst: Declarações forma feitas durante sabatina, na noite de quarta-feira (9). JHC (PSDB) é candidato ao governo de Alagoas nas Eleições 2026.
articles.summary: Declarações forma feitas durante sabatina, na noite de quarta-feira (9). JHC (PSDB) é candidato ao governo de Alagoas nas Eleições 2026.
articles.body:
JHC (PSDB) durante sabatina na TV Pajuçara, em Maceió — Foto: Reprodução/TV Pajuçara

O candidato ao governo de Alagoas João Henrique Caldas, o JHC ( PSDB ), afirmou, na noite de quarta-feira (8), que, se eleito, pretende criar o programa “Territórios da Paz”. A proposta prevê a realização de obras em áreas de vulnerabilidade social, com a instalação de equipamentos de lazer e espaços de convivência para incentivar a ocupação desses locais e reduzir a criminalidade.

A afirmação foi feita durante uma sabatina na TV Pajuçara com candidatos ao governo do estado.

Além do programa voltado à Segurança Pública, JHC afirmou que pretende criar mais policlínicas no estado, implantar uma nova macrorregião de saúde, combater o analfabetismo e construir um presídio destinado ao regime semiaberto.

Entre as propostas apresentadas pelo candidato para a área da Saúde está a criação de uma terceira macrorregião para atender moradores do Sertão e do Alto Sertão, evitando o deslocamento da população para outras regiões do estado.

JHC também propôs a criação da “Tabela Alagoana”, que funcionaria como um complemento ao Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), com o objetivo de incentivar os municípios a ampliar a oferta de serviços básicos e exames.

O candidato afirmou ainda que pretende implantar policlínicas com atendimento especializado nas 10 regiões de saúde de Alagoas.

Se eleito governador de Alagoas, o ex-prefeito de Maceió afirmou que pretende reduzir a taxa de analfabetismo no estado. Para isso, disse que irá oferecer bolsas financeiras para incentivar idosos e adultos a retornar às salas de aula.

O candidato também informou que pretende ampliar a oferta de creches para atender crianças na primeira infância, período que vai da gestação aos seis anos de idade. Os equipamentos deverão seguir o modelo de creches em tempo integral, como os “Gigantinhos”.

Segundo JHC, atualmente, o modelo oferece seis refeições diárias, postos de vacinação, ações de higiene pessoal e atendimento por telemedicina para as crianças matriculadas nas creches de Maceió.

Entre as ações para a área da Segurança Pública, JHC destacou a criação do programa “Territórios da Paz”, que pretende ocupar áreas de alta vulnerabilidade social com equipamentos de convivência e lazer.

Ele afirmou ainda que pretende modernizar e valorizar as polícias Militar, Civil e Científica, fortalecer a inteligência das forças de segurança e investir em ações de policiamento de proximidade.

Outra proposta apresentada pelo candidato foi a construção de um presídio destinado ao regime semiaberto, para que os condenados possam cumprir as sentenças judiciais de forma adequada no estado.

Durante a sabatina, JHC também propôs a criação do Programa Alagoas Trabalha, uma iniciativa para descentralizar a geração de emprego e renda da Região Metropolitana de Maceió para o interior do estado.

Entre as propostas está ainda o Banco da Mulher Empreendedora, que prevê a concessão de crédito de até R$ 3,6 mil para mulheres que desejam empreender.

Na área de saneamento básico, JHC afirmou que pretende realizar auditorias e ampliar a fiscalização dos contratos com as concessionárias de água por meio da Agência Reguladora de Serviços Públicos do Estado de Alagoas (Arsal).

O candidato ao governo também disse que pretende garantir autonomia às prefeituras para que possam fiscalizar a qualidade dos serviços e os valores cobrados pelas concessionárias.

articles.title: Agências da Caixa no TO fecham após bancários entrarem em greve | G1
articles.standfirst: Paralisação por tempo indeterminado afeta serviço em 14 municípios do Tocantins. Atendimento pelos canais digitais da instituição segue funcionando.
articles.summary: Paralisação por tempo indeterminado afeta serviço em 14 municípios do Tocantins. Atendimento pelos canais digitais da instituição segue funcionando.
articles.body:
Agências da Caixa Econômica no Tocantins estarão fechadas por tempo indeterminado a partir desta quinta-feira (10), em razão da greve dos bancários. A paralisação afeta 21 agências em 14 municípios do estado.

De acordo com o Sindicato dos Bancários do Tocantins (SINTEC-TO), a greve foi aprovada pela categoria após a rejeição da proposta apresentada pela Caixa para renovação do Acordo Coletivo de Trabalho (ACT).

Com a greve, alguns serviços da Caixa serão afetados. Segundo o sindicato, o atendimento presencial está suspenso e o atendimento pelos canais digitais como Agência Digital Caixa, autoatendimento, aplicativo e site Caixa e WhatsApp Caixa será mantido.

📱 Clique aqui para seguir o canal do g1 TO no WhatsApp

Entre os principais pontos defendidos pelos trabalhadores está a manutenção de um Saúde Caixa acessível e sustentável, sem mudanças que aumentem os custos para os empregados e seus dependentes. A pauta também inclui melhores condições de trabalho, valorização profissional, combate às metas abusivas e redução da sobrecarga nas agências.

Bancários da Caixa Econômica Federal entram em greve no TO — Foto: Reprodução/TV Anhanguera

O sindicato organizou uma mobilização a partir das 9h em Palmas, em frente à Agência Caixa Serra do Carmo, na Quadra 104 Sul. Nas demais cidades do estado, a orientação é para que as unidades da Caixa permaneçam fechadas durante a greve.

A greve dos funcionários do Banco do Brasil, que também estava prevista, foi suspensa após orientação da Confederação Nacional das Empresas de Crédito (CONTEC). Será realizada uma nova assembleia para reavaliar a proposta apresentada pela instituição.

Após a reunião, os bancários do Banco do Brasil voltarão a deliberar sobre os rumos da Campanha Salarial em nova votação convocada pelo sindicato.

articles.title: Caixa entra em greve e BB tem paralisação parcial nesta quinta | G1
articles.standfirst: Nova convenção coletiva prevê reposição da inflação e aumento real de 0,6% nos salários. Funcionários da Caixa e parte dos trabalhadores do BB rejeitaram as propostas.
articles.summary: Na Caixa, trabalhadores rejeitaram a proposta de renovação da convenção coletiva; no Banco do Brasil, 60 sindicatos não aprovaram o acordo.
articles.body:
Caixa Econômica Federal — Foto: Caixa Econômica Federal/Divulgação

Os funcionários da Caixa Econômica Federal e do Banco do Brasil entram em greve por tempo indeterminado a partir desta quinta-feira (10).

Na Caixa, a paralisação é nacional e acontece após rejeitarem a proposta de renovação do Acordo Coletivo de Trabalho (ACT).

No Banco do Brasil, a greve é parcial e ocorre apenas nas bases sindicais que não aprovaram o acordo da categoria.

A greve da Caixa foi aprovada pelos trabalhadores da base do Sindicato dos Bancários de São Paulo, Osasco e Região em assembleia encerrada no dia 4 de agosto. Segundo a entidade, a paralisação é nacional.

No Banco do Brasil, a nova Convenção Coletiva de Trabalho (CCT) foi aprovada por parte dos sindicatos, mas rejeitada por outras 60 entidades. Entre as bases que não aprovaram o acordo estão Brasília, Rio de Janeiro, Porto Alegre, Pernambuco e Florianópolis.

A nova Convenção Coletiva de Trabalho (CCT) da categoria foi assinada nesta quarta-feira (9), em São Paulo, pela Federação Nacional dos Bancos (Fenaban) e pelos bancários.

O acordo prevê a reposição integral da inflação medida pelo Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor (INPC), mais aumento real de 0,6% nos próximos dois anos.

O reajuste também será aplicado a outras verbas, como vale-alimentação (VA), vale-refeição (VR), Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR) e auxílios.

Além dos reajustes, a convenção inclui medidas relacionadas à saúde mental e ao combate ao assédio no ambiente de trabalho, além de regras sobre o direito à desconexão fora do horário de expediente e transparência e limites para o monitoramento digital dos funcionários.

O acordo também prevê a criação de um programa de qualificação e recolocação profissional e melhorias na indenização paga a trabalhadores de bancos privados demitidos em razão do fechamento de agências.

O g1 procurou os sindicatos dos bancários e a Confederação Nacional dos Trabalhadores do Ramo Financeiro (Contraf-CUT) e a Confederação Nacional dos Trabalhadores de Crédito (Contec) para entender os principais motivos da rejeição da proposta por parte dos trabalhadores.

Em nota enviada ao g1 , o Banco do Brasil afirmou que participa da mesa única de negociação da Federação Nacional dos Bancos (Fenaban), que reúne os bancos para discutir questões gerais da categoria, incluindo o índice de reajuste.

O banco também mantém uma mesa específica com as entidades sindicais para tratar de questões relacionadas aos funcionários do BB.

Segundo a instituição, foram realizadas diversas rodadas de negociação para a data-base de 2026, que resultaram na proposta apresentada às entidades sindicais e aprovada em assembleias de trabalhadores em diferentes regiões do país.

O BB informou ainda que, durante a paralisação, os clientes podem utilizar o aplicativo, o Internet Banking, os correspondentes bancários e a Central de Relacionamento, pelos telefones 4004-0001 (capitais e regiões metropolitanas) e 0800 729 0001 (demais localidades), além do WhatsApp, pelo número (61) 4001-0001.

O g1 também procurou a Caixa Econômica Federal e a Federação Brasileira de Bancos (Febraban) e aguarda posicionamento.

Na Caixa, os trabalhadores não aprovaram a proposta de renovação do Acordo Coletivo de Trabalho (ACT) apresentada pelo banco. Com a rejeição, os empregados decidiram iniciar uma greve por tempo indeterminado.

Na terça-feira (8), a Caixa enviou um ofício à Confederação Nacional dos Trabalhadores do Ramo Financeiro (Contraf-CUT) para convocar a entidade para uma reunião de negociação na última quarta-feira (9).

A Contraf-CUT representa os empregados da Caixa nas negociações específicas do banco, enquanto a CCT assinada nesta quarta-feira estabelece as regras gerais para a categoria bancária.

Segundo Contraf-CUT, a proposta apresentada pelo banco foi rejeitada por mais de 90% das bases sindicais em assembleias realizadas pelo país.

A entidade afirma que, apesar de a Caixa não ter apresentado uma nova proposta, o banco se comprometeu a avançar nas negociações e marcou uma nova reunião para a manhã desta quinta-feira (10).

Segundo a Comissão Executiva dos Empregados (CEE), a paralisação deve ser mantida até que novas assembleias avaliem eventuais avanços na negociação. Entre os principais pontos de discordância está o Saúde Caixa, além de outras reivindicações apresentadas pelos trabalhadores desde junho.

Segundo o Sindicato dos Bancários de São Paulo, a renovação da Convenção Coletiva de Trabalho (CCT) foi resultado de 13 rodadas de negociação realizadas ao longo de mais de dois meses.

Além dos reajustes salariais, a entidade destaca medidas voltadas à prevenção do adoecimento mental, combate ao assédio e proteção do direito à desconexão. Também foram incluídas regras para dar mais transparência ao monitoramento digital dos trabalhadores.

A presidenta do Sindicato dos Bancários de São Paulo, Osasco e Região e uma das coordenadoras do Comando Nacional dos Bancários, Neiva Ribeiro, afirmou que a negociação garantiu aumento real por dois anos e a manutenção das cláusulas previstas na convenção.

A dirigente também citou como próximos temas de negociação a aplicação da NR-1, o combate às metas abusivas e a busca por ambientes de trabalho considerados mais saudáveis pela categoria.

articles.title: Nitin Gadkari says he felt ‘ashamed’ at Mumbai-Goa highway work delays; ‘I want to set record of blacklisting maximum number of contractors and suspending officials for poor quality work’
articles.summary: India Business News: Union Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari has said that he wants to set a record blacklisting contractors who do poor quality work and .
articles.body: Union Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari has said that he wants to set a record blacklisting contractors who do poor quality work and also suspend officials.Gadkari said he had earlier expressed shame over the prolonged delay in widening the Mumbai-Goa Highway. He now plans to travel along the highway in October and personally review the work that has been completed.He was speaking after inaugurating a six-lane elevated road corridor at Porvorim near Panaji. Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant, Union Minister Shripad Naik, State Public Works Department Minister Digambar Kamat, Tourism Minister Rohan Khaunte and other officials were present at the event.‘Want to set record for blacklisting contractors, suspending officials’Gadkari said on Wednesday that he wanted to "set a record" by blacklisting the largest possible number of contractors and suspending officials found responsible for delays or poor-quality execution in infrastructure projects."I had announced (earlier) that I would not come for the inauguration of the (widened) Mumbai-Goa highway because I felt ashamed that it had been delayed so much," he said.According to Gadkari, officials held a meeting on the issue on Tuesday."I would land at the Mumbai airport in October, and travel by road to Goa to personally inspect the highway and assess whether the journey has been made convenient for travellers," he said.The minister said the government would continue taking stringent action against contractors and officials responsible for delays and substandard execution of infrastructure projects."Now I want to set a record of blacklisting the maximum number of contractors and taking action against them, as well as suspending officials, within a year. I am not going to stop doing this now," he said.Gadkari also called on the Goa government to develop roadside amenities along the Mumbai-Goa highway that reflect the state's distinctive architecture, cuisine and handicraft traditions.He said these facilities should offer visitors an opportunity to experience Goan food and purchase the state's handloom and handicraft products, giving tourists a distinctive experience as they travel through Goa.Gadkari also proposed adding facilities for biofuels, electric vehicles and other alternative fuels alongside the petrol and diesel pumps operating on the route."If you make a request to me, I am ready to provide them to you," Gadkari said.Mumbai-Goa highway widening delayedThe widening work on the Mumbai-Goa highway, which runs through Maharashtra's coastal Konkan region, has been delayed repeatedly.He also said landscaping along the highway should be planned scientifically rather than relying on contractors to carry out arbitrary tree plantation."Proper study should be conducted to determine which flowering trees and species should be planted, and which species absorb more carbon dioxide and release oxygen," the minister said.Gadkari appealed to Chief Minister Sawant and local MLAs to support efforts to turn the entire highway into a "green highway". He also suggested that it could be developed along the lines of an "oxygen park".The minister pointed out that he had previously developed an oxygen park in Nagpur.He said quality infrastructure covering water, electricity, transportation and communication is important for attracting investment, generating employment and helping reduce poverty.Gadkari further called for Goa to work towards eliminating water, air and noise pollution. He urged the authorities to ensure that waste does not find its way into the sea.He also sought a comprehensive review of traffic conditions in the state and reforms to address congestion. Among the measures he suggested were consolidating markets, relocating warehouses outside cities, upgrading bus depots and synchronising traffic movement.Referring to the newly inaugurated elevated corridor at Porvorim, Gadkari said a road that originally had a two-lane capacity now effectively provides capacity for ten lanes, with four lanes at ground level and six lanes on the elevated section.The minister also pushed for wider adoption of alternative fuels and technologies such as electric, hydrogen and flex-fuel systems, saying these would contribute to lowering pollution.Get the latest Business News and Live updates. articles.title: Red, White, and Sacre Bleu: Americans are buying up homes in Paris
articles.summary: More Americans are moving to Paris and buying homes, often paying a premium and reshaping parts of the city's luxury real estate market.
articles.body:
Getting fired after a reorganization at his firm wasn't ideal, but Marty Yabrow and his wife, Angie, wanted to make the best of it, so in 2024 they booked a three-city trip to Europe. Then, one morning while Marty was filling out a planning spreadsheet with hotels and restaurants, Angie asked out of the blue, "Why don't we just move there instead?" Marty was quick to react.

"I deleted that spreadsheet, and I started a new one," he says.

Despite some initial misgivings from their financial advisor, Marty, 68, crunched the numbers and found that it was not only financially possible but also preferable to retire in France , since he and Angie, 73, would benefit from free healthcare. After selling their home in Atlanta, they moved to Paris in January 2025.

A growing number of Americans have been flocking to the French capital, seeking a better work-life balance, a slightly cheaper cost of living, or some distance from politics back home. And unlike previous generations of uber-wealthy Americans investing in pied-à-terre properties, more people are making a permanent move . In 2025, 15,388 Americans applied for a French residency permit, a 17.3% increase from the previous year.

Parisians, meanwhile, are ambivalent about welcoming the Yanks. On the downside, the new wave of Américains is driving up housing prices for locals investing in their own high-end properties. On the upside, the rush of real estate cash is creating new financial opportunities and greasing the wheels of the housing market as many French people look to downsize.

"Americans are among the biggest foreign buyers in France," says Maître Angélique Devaux, a notary in Paris.

They also tend to spend more: In Paris, one in four foreign buyers is American, and their average budget of 825,000 euros (roughly $950,000) exceeds the average value of both foreign and French purchases.

These new expats are seduced by the historic neighborhoods: Odéon and Saint-Germain-des-Prés on one side of the river, Le Marais and the Triangle d'Or on the other. They're interested in postcard Paris, says Guillaume de Blaÿ, managing partner at Barnes Bac-Varenne, a brokerage that has long served those looking for luxurious properties.

"Have you heard of 'Emily in Paris'? That's the sort of imagery I'm talking about," he says.

Like the titular Emily , American buyers are also up for an adventure. They're slowly looking further from the epicenter, venturing into neighborhoods where real (wealthy) Parisians live, such as Nouvelle Athènes and Montparnasse, close to bilingual schools and major parks. Some are even exploring the (chicer) suburbs. Regardless of where they settle, Americans are changing what is being sold and how.

articles.title: 28-year-old woman has Rs 2 crore net worth and no EMIs; with husband earning Rs 3 lakh a month, she asks if she can quit her job
articles.summary: India Business News: Imagine accumulating a net worth of around Rs 2 crore before you turn 30 years of age. What should your next course of action be?A 28-year-old woman h.
articles.body: Imagine accumulating a net worth of around Rs 2 crore before you turn 30 years of age. What should your next course of action be?A 28-year-old woman has claimed on Reddit that she has a net worth of around Rs 2 crore, earns about Rs 4 lakh a month and has no EMIs to pay. According to her Reddit post, her husband earns another Rs 3 lakh a month and has a net worth of around Rs 1.5 crore. Yet the couple is wondering whether they can afford to live on a single income.Networth in croresThe woman, who identified herself as a senior software engineer, shared her financial details on the personal finance forum in February this year.She claimed that her investments include Rs 75 lakh in mutual funds, Rs 35 lakh in gold, Rs 35 lakh in company stocks, Rs 20 lakh in fixed deposits, Rs 13 lakh in EPF and Rs 10 lakh in NPS. She has another Rs 7 lakh lent to others, Rs 4 lakh in savings accounts and Rs 1 lakh in Sovereign Gold Bonds and RBI Bonds.Her husband earns close to Rs 3 lakh a month, while she says her take-home income, including company stocks, is around Rs 4 lakh a month. The couple currently has no EMIs and estimates their monthly expenses at between Rs 50,000 and Rs 1 lakh.The couple does not have children yet but plans to have one in the next year or two. The woman said both of them are finding it stressful to manage work and the household at the same time. She enjoys managing the household and is therefore considering leaving her job and shifting to a single-income household supported by her husband's salary.“Are we in good shape to shift to single income household from my husband's salary and I am planning to manage the household since we are finding it stressful to manage both work and house. I like managing the household,” she says in her post.She also said they want to be prepared for major uncertainties, including the possibility of AI affecting jobs. While she felt that quitting looked possible in an optimistic scenario, she was unsure about how the decision would work out under a more pessimistic scenario.“We want to be well prepared in case of major events like AI taking over jobs or other uncertain events. While in an optimistic scenario it looks like I can quit my office job, but not sure of a pessimistic scenario. What do you think?,” she posted inviting opinion.How she built the networthA user on Reddit asked the woman how she managed to build such a networth. Her explanation of how she built the Rs 2 crore corpus was fairly straightforward. She said she had been careful with spending from the beginning, started SIPs as soon as she received her first salary and invested consistently. She said she never had expensive habits or much interest in spending.The Covid period also played a role in how much she was able to save. She spent three years in her hometown during the period, which she said kept her expenses very low.As a result, most of her income went into savings. She also said she started her career outside the large technology companies, switched jobs every two to three years and benefited from the strong compensation available during the Covid period.People respond to the postThe post triggered a divided response. Some Reddit users questioned why someone with a Rs 2 crore net worth and a Rs 4 lakh monthly income needed advice on whether she could manage financially. Others took the question more seriously and suggested that she should consider the loss of income before leaving a well-paying career.Several commenters suggested a middle path instead of quitting altogether. One recommended moving to a less stressful job even if it meant accepting a lower salary. Others suggested hiring domestic help and making the existing job easier to manage.The woman explained that the problem was not simply poor work-life balance. She wanted enough time to cook her own food, rest, pursue fitness and health, and have some leisure time. With both partners working, she said their days had become a constant rush between work, commuting and household responsibilities.(Disclaimer: The Times of India could not independently verify the claims of the Reddit user. Tanzania is an important economic partner for India and a gateway to East Africa, with growing demand for travel driven by trade, investment, tourism and cultural ties. articles.summary: International Business News: China on Thursday described its economic and trade cooperation with India as \"mutually beneficial and win-win in nature\" and urged New Delhi to provid.
articles.body: China on Thursday described its economic and trade cooperation with India as "mutually beneficial and win-win in nature" and urged New Delhi to provide a fair, transparent and non-discriminatory business environment for Chinese companies operating in the country.Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun made the remarks at a press briefing when asked about reports that India's Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO) had recommended a detailed investigation into the Indian operations of Chinese smartphone maker Xiaomi."I am not aware of the specific situation," Guo said, while adding that China hopes India will provide a "fair, just, transparent and non-discriminatory business environment" for companies from all countries investing and operating in India."China-India economic and trade cooperation is mutually beneficial and win-win in nature," he said, according to ANI.The SFIO has sought approval from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs for a deeper probe into Xiaomi's India operations. The proposed investigation is expected to examine fund transfers and whether the company secured mandatory investment approvals under Indian laws.Xiaomi has said it has not received any notice or communication from the SFIO and maintains that it fully complies with Indian laws.India's Ambassador to China Vikram Doraiswami has also called for deeper cooperation between the two countries in areas including trade, the economy, climate action and the digital sector.In an opinion piece published in the Chinese daily Global Times, Doraiswami said a "stable, predictable, and amicable" India-China relationship would benefit not only the two countries' combined population of around 2.8 billion people but also contribute to global peace, stability and prosperity.Guo, meanwhile, declined to elaborate when asked whether Chinese President Xi Jinping would visit India for the BRICS Summit later this week.Xi is set to attend the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12 and 13 at the invitation of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The visit will be his first to India in seven years, as New Delhi and Beijing work to stabilise ties following years of tensions over their disputed border.Xi is expected to travel with a large delegation, reportedly more than twice the size of the Chinese contingent that accompanied him during his last visit to India in 2019, according to Reuters.His visit has also drawn attention to the possibility of a meeting between Modi and Xi on the sidelines of the summit. Relations between the two countries have gradually improved since the tensions triggered by the 2020 Galwan clashes.India is hosting the 18th BRICS Summit under the theme "Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability", with a human-centric approach across its core pillars aimed at strengthening institutions and supporting sustainable growth.Get the latest Business News and Live updates. articles.body: NEW DELHI: With the 18th Brics Leaders’ Summit set to begin in New Delhi, the capital is preparing for a weekend of heightened security, traffic restrictions and government office closures. This has also prompted questions over whether banks will remain shut tomorrow on September 11.So, are banks closed on Friday?Not across the country. The Reserve Bank of India’s holiday calendar lists September 11 as a bank holiday in Rajasthan, where branches will remain closed due to elections in the jurisdiction of the Jaipur Municipal Corporation. The RBI calendar does not list September 11 as a bank holiday in Delhi, meaning bank branches in the national capital are not closed merely because of the summit.However, bank operations could also be affected by a nationwide strike called by the United Forum of Bank Unions (UFBU) on September 11. The forum, which claims to represent more than 90 per cent of the banking workforce, is protesting over the long-pending demand for a five-day banking week, the revised Performance Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme and other unresolved issues. The unions have also announced a three-day strike from September 28 to 30, followed by an indefinite strike from October 26 if their demands are not addressed. The strike is a union-led agitation and is separate from the RBI’s bank holiday calendar.Several major banks have warned customers that branch and office operations could be affected by the strike. State Bank of India (SBI) said it has made arrangements for normal functioning at its branches and offices but acknowledged that work across the bank may still be impacted.Punjab National Bank (PNB), UCO Bank , Indian Bankand Bank of Maharashtra have also issued advisories warning of possible disruption to banking services on September 11.In Gujarat, customers could face another disruption as the Maha Gujarat Bank Employees’ Association (MGBEA) has called a strike from September 11 to 13. With September 12 being the second Saturday and September 13 a Sunday, public sector bank branches in the state could remain shut for three days at a stretch. The association has said around 5,400 branches and 75,000 employees and officers are expected to participate, potentially affecting transactions worth around Rs 15,000 crore.Read more: Three-day bank strike from Sep 11 in Gujarat; 5,400 branches to remain shut, Rs 15,000 crore of transactions to be affectedWhat are the other bank holidays in September?Banks will remain closed in Assam on September 12 due to Tirubhav Tithi of Srimanta Sankardeva. articles.title: Macy's turnaround shows promise as earnings beat estimates, outlook improves
articles.summary: Macy's outlook continues to improve as its turnaround strategy enters its third year.
articles.body:
Macy's ( M ) turnaround efforts continued to gain momentum in the second quarter, giving the department store chain leeway to raise its cautious guidance again.

In the second quarter, Macy's same-store sales rose 2.7%, marking the fifth straight quarter of growth and widely surpassing Wall Street's expectations for 0.8% comparable sales growth, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence data.

Macy's luxury store, Bloomingdale's, shone yet again with 11.3% sales growth in the quarter, while beauty chain Bluemercury's sales grew 6.2%. Macy's flagship brand posted 1.1% sales growth, with newly revamped stores reporting a modestly stronger 1.9% growth.

The company is in the third year of its "Bold New Chapter" transformation strategy, pegged on closing 150 underperforming stores and reinvesting in the remaining 350 locations. It's also hoping that editing out redundant merchandise and adding fashionable brands, such as Theory and Free People, will appeal to Macy's middle- to upper-income consumers, who have shown greater resilience amid rising consumer pressures.

"The investments we're making are driving results across our portfolio, from the continued outperformance of our Reimagine 200 Macy's stores, to meaningful double-digit growth at Bloomingdale's and another solid quarter at Bluemercury," Macy's CEO Tony Spring said in the earnings release. "As we enter the second half of the year, we remain focused on scaling what is resonating most with customers — exciting brands and assortments and compelling events and experiences."

Macy's stock fell in premarket trading on Thursday. Heading into the results, Wall Street had remained cautious on the stock, which has risen less than 2% year to date, compared with a 12% gain for the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ).

Macy's beat analyst estimates on the top and bottom lines as well. Adjusted earnings of $0.63 per share doubled compared to the same quarter a year ago and beat the Street's estimate of $0.37 per share, helped in part by a $0.23 per share boost from tariff refunds. Net sales of $4.87 billion also beat expectations of $4.8 billion.

Macy's said it received all of the expected refunds from the IEEPA tariffs that the Supreme Court struck down in February. Since the beginning of the second quarter, Macy's collected $116 million in tariff refunds. The company plans to direct $20 million of those proceeds to profits and reinvest the remaining $96 million in the company.

The results come as consumer sentiment remains dampened , with high gas prices and macroeconomic uncertainty taking their toll. Throughout the second quarter earnings season, businesses have highlighted that the retail landscape has become highly promotional as consumers continue to spend but have become choosier about what to splurge on.

articles.title: Internship the new interview: Companies turning interns into full-time hires; what it means for IT sector jobs
articles.summary: India Business News: In a job market that sees frequent headlines of layoffs, the emerging hiring trends hold significance, particularly for entry-level placements. A new .
articles.body: In a job market that sees frequent headlines of layoffs, the emerging hiring trends hold significance, particularly for entry-level placements. A new report by Deloitte India suggests that the journey from internship to a Pre-Placement Offer, or PPO is becoming increasingly important.For students who are entering the job market, an internship is no longer just a line on their resume. It can be the first real test of whether a company sees them as a potential full-time employee.“Internships are increasingly evolving from a short-term assessment mechanism into a strategic talent pipeline. Our Campus Workforce Trends 2026 study shows a roughly 6% increase in PPO conversions and growing organisational investment in apprenticeship and internship programmes,” says Neelesh Gupta, Partner, Deloitte India.What does this mean for the job prospects of freshers - B.Tech, M.Tech, BBAs, MBAs? Let’s dive deep:The changing trendAccording to Deloitte’s Campus Workforce Trends 2026 report, the overall pre-placement offer conversion rates have increased by approximately 6% YoY. The report attributes this to stronger adoption of internship-to-hire programmes and sustained demand for pre-assessed campus talent.The report says that organisations are increasingly leveraging internship-to-hire programmes to improve hiring efficiency, retain proven talent and reduce external hiring risks.In fact, according to the report, the PPO conversion rates have improved across all major programmes; be it MBA or B.Tech.According to Deloitte’s Neelesh Gupta, ⁠65-70% of organisations invest in structured apprenticeships and long-term internships to improve practical exposure and conversion outcomes. The main play for internship to PPO conversion is to lock in talent in the first or the second trimester (or initial part of their course) after assessing the candidate for an elongated period of 2 months instead of just a performance in an interview.“Thereafter, plan for structured acclimatisation and onboarding during the balance of the course. Please note that once a student is offered a PPO by an organization, he / she is signed out from the campus placement process by their institution and therefore cannot apply for placement in any other organization (ergo lock in),” he tells TOI.According to the Deloitte expert:MBA graduates continue to command the highest internship stipends, with median stipends of approximately:Rs 1.8-1.9 lakh/month at Top 10 institutesRs 1.2-1.3 lakh/month at Tier 1 institutesRs 55,000-75,000/month at Tier 2 institutesRs 26,000/month at Tier 3 institutesEngineering graduates (B.E./B.Tech and M.E./M.Tech) receive the second-highest stipend levels:Rs 90,000-1.2 lakh/month at Top 10 institutesRs 60,000-80,000/month at Tier 1 institutesRs 30,000-45,000/month at Tier 2 institutesRs 15,000-25,000/month at Tier 3 institutesNeeti Sharma, CEO at TeamLease Digital sees this as a shift from “hire and train” to “test and hire.” Companies want to see how a candidate performs in a real work environment before making a full-time commitment.“Hence, many companies today are using the internships or apprenticeships as a route to identify the right candidate early on, train them on the job and make this cohort part of their future workforce plan,” she tells TOI.“About 80% of employers, including many GCCs, are planning to increase apprentice intake so internships and apprenticeships are becoming a more structured talent pipeline, rather than just a profile booster,” she adds.As Diwakar Chittora, Founder and CEO, Intellipaat notes: A 15–30 minute interview is often too small a window to accurately evaluate a fresher across all these dimensions.An internship allows companies to see how candidates actually approach problems, learn new skills, collaborate with teams, communicate, cultural fitment and perform in a real working environment before making a long-term hiring decision.IT sector in focusSince the IT sector is one of the big campus placement employers, absorbing thousands in a go, the new trend raises an important question: is internship-to-PPO the route that the IT sector is also increasingly adopting?Yes, say experts.Neeti Sharma of TeamLease Digital says that the shift is most visible in the IT sector.“Fresher hiring intent in IT has softened from 81% to 76%, even as overall fresher hiring intent has increased. That tells us IT is becoming more selective about entry-level talent. With AI changing the nature of junior tech jobs, companies increasingly want candidates who can demonstrate that they can actually build, use and deploy technology, not just talk about it. So the internship or apprenticeship is becoming a bridge between education and employability, particularly in technology,” she tells TOI.Deloitte’s report shows continued strong demand for technology talent. The report also highlights growing demand for specialised technology roles such as Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, Technical Programme Manager, Site Reliability Engineer and Cloud-related roles, alongside increasing emphasis on skills-first hiring.“Therefore, organisations are looking for internships in this sector through twofold lens: One, solving some of their critical business challenges through strategic projects being offered to interns who bring in fresh perspective and latest technology understanding and two; evaluate fitment over a long period (2/3 months) instead of just an interview/assessment performance,” says Neelesh Gupta of Deloitte India.What does it mean for freshers and campus placements?Experts say the hiring landscape is becoming more nuanced, though not necessarily narrower.“It may make direct campus hiring more selective, but I would not necessarily see that as negative for fresh graduates,” says Diwakar Chittora.Traditionally, fresher hiring, especially in large technology companies, has often happened at scale. A student may accept an offer primarily because they need their first job, without necessarily knowing which technology, business unit or project they will eventually be assigned to.“That first project can then significantly influence their career direction for the next several years. Internship-led hiring can make this process more transparent and better aligned. Students get exposure to the actual work, while companies can identify candidates who demonstrate the right skills and aptitude,” Chittora tells TOI.The signal is clear: Internships are becoming increasingly important.“For students nowadays it is clear, they cannot depend only on a degree and a campus interview anymore. Internships, projects, hackathons and demonstrable skills are becoming increasingly important signals of employability,” he adds.Deloitte’s report also finds that organisations are increasingly prioritising candidates who demonstrate stronger role fit, performance during internships and job readiness.The report notes a shift towards quality of hire and higher emphasis on internship performance. In fact, data from the report shows that the attrition rates up to two years of joining a job also fall when the hiring has happened through the internship to PPO route.Neeti Sharma notes that employer intent to hire freshers actually rose to 75% in H2 2026, from 73% in H1.“The change is in what employers expect. A degree is increasingly the starting point, not the differentiator. Companies want evidence of practical skills through internships, apprenticeships, projects or certifications before making a permanent offer,” she says.The bottom lineExperts say that rather than reducing opportunities, internship programmes appear to be evolving into an additional evaluation and conversion channel.Fresh graduates often enter a job without knowing enough exposure to understand whether they genuinely want to build their career in that particular tool or domain. An internship gives them an opportunity to experience the role before committing to it.Diwakar Chittora sees this largely a win-win model: Companies get to test talent before hiring, and candidates get to test a career before committing to it.From an IT sector perspective, however, he doesn’t see internships completely replacing traditional campus hiring, particularly for companies hiring thousands of graduates every year.“Instead, we are likely to see a hybrid model, where campus hiring continues but internships, pre-placement offers and project-based evaluation play a much bigger role in determining who finally gets hired,” he says.“The bottom line is that internship to PPO conversions are the pathway to a permanent role in an organization. In case a student is not able to secure a PPO post internship, they have to compete for permanent roles during the balance of the campus placement cycles when organizations come for placement. Since PPO conversions range between 15-20% of the class, the majority part of the placement happens outside the internship route,” says Neelesh Gupta.However, he cautions that the trend should not be interpreted as a replacement for campus hiring.“Instead, organisations are using internships to identify job-ready talent earlier, improve hiring quality and strengthen long-term retention, while continuing to invest significantly in direct campus recruitment.” he concludes.Get the latest Business News and Live updates. articles.title: Why AT&T CEO sees a 'complementary dynamic' with Elon Musk's Starlink
articles.summary: AT&T CEO John Stankey sees opportunities amid Starlink's wireless expansion.
articles.body:
SAN FRANCISCO, Calif. — If you're thinking SpaceX's ( SPCX ) Starlink is going to run roughshod over well-established wireless operators such as AT&T ( T ), T-Mobile ( TMUS ), and Verizon ( VZ ), not so fast.

"It [Starlink] doesn't get through buildings very well," AT&T CEO John Stankey told Yahoo Finance from the Goldman Sachs Communacopia & Tech Conference (video above). "It does very well [with a] line of sight. If you have a lower-band spectrum, then it will have some decent penetration into some buildings. But it's not going to penetrate the skin of a high-rise. It's not going to penetrate a stadium where people are congregated to watch a World Cup game and be able to have the social experiences that they demand in those circumstances."

"I think customers have a pretty high bar of how networks have to perform," Stankey added. "And I think we're uniquely positioned to continue to meet those expectations."

Concerns are escalating across Wall Street that Elon Musk's Starlink could disrupt legacy wireless operators like AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile by transitioning from a rural broadband service into a direct mobile competitor.

Following its strategic acquisition of terrestrial spectrum and rapid deployment of advanced satellites, SpaceX has laid the groundwork to launch its own standalone cellular network alongside its direct-to-cell capabilities.

The expansion threatens traditional carriers' high-margin enterprise, emergency service, and rural subscriber bases, as well as lucrative international roaming revenues.

"I think they're going to find places where they clearly have a good solution," Stankey added. "In airlines and flights today, they have a fantastic broadband solution. In rural parts or territories, it's a very efficient way to get good bandwidth to people. I think we see that there's going to be some IoT-type applications, like connecting vehicles that are largely outdoors and maybe have line of sight to the sky, that they're going to have an opportunity to go in and do some things there that maybe we haven't done as effectively."

So, while Starlink will present competition, Stankey added, "there's also going to be the complementary dynamic of us being able to solve that other 2% of the use cases I talked about and bring our customers to those satellite operators, whether it be Amazon or SpaceX. They'll be the beneficiary of us aggregating that traffic and bringing it into the wholesale market to be able to be used."

Shares of AT&T & T-Mobile, seen as industry leaders in the space, have lagged the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) this year amid these swirling Starlink concerns.

articles.title: Kevin Warsh's Fed strategy risks 'unproductive volatility' in markets: Jan Hatzius
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs chief economist Jan Hatzius keeps it real on the Fed.
articles.body:
SAN FRANCISCO, Calif. — Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's more secretive approach to policy guidance could come back to bite him.

"I am in agreement that forward guidance about the path of the funds rate isn't needed in the current environment — that's really something that should be reserved for crisis situations where we're at or close to zero on the funds rate," Goldman Sachs chief economist Jan Hatzius told Yahoo Finance at the firm's Communacopia & Tech conference (video above). "Transparency about the thought process, I do think, is important. If investors understand how the Fed is going to react to new information, then they can anticipate those reactions that accelerate the transmission of monetary policy and that ultimately reduces the lags of monetary policy."

Hatzius added, "I think markets are still going to try to figure out what the Fed is thinking, but they'll have less information, less of a basis on which to do that. And that's going to mean more volatility. I mean, volatility per se isn't bad when you have new information about the economy. Of course, rate expectations and financial conditions do need to move, but if you get volatility because people don't understand the central bank's thought process, then that's more unproductive volatility."

Warsh is off to a somewhat rocky start leading the world's most powerful central bank.

During his debut keynote address as Fed chair at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium a couple of weeks ago, Warsh adopted a hawkish stance on interest rate policy, warning that the central bank's fight against inflation is far from over.

With inflation "running above our 2% target … the Fed's predominant focus right now should be on prices," Warsh said.

Warsh characterized recent inflation numbers as "concerning" and added that "we must be confident that underlying inflation is moving to our objective, clearly and at sufficient speed … otherwise, we have work to do."

Investors were hoping Warsh might hint at an upcoming interest rate cut or a softer stance on inflation. No luck.

Instead, his adamant focus on maintaining the 2% inflation target — paired with remarks implying financial conditions may not yet be restrictive enough — pushed Treasury yields higher.

Traders moved to price in a nearly 61% probability of an interest rate hike at the mid-September FOMC meeting.

Not helping investors has been Warsh's style of communication, as he prefers not to give clear guidance on what's next for policy. This differs from his recent predecessors Jerome Powell, Janet Yellen, and Ben Bernanke.

articles.title: Govt tightens e-commerce rules: Price transparency to curbing dark patterns, key changes explained
articles.summary: India Business News: NEW DELHI: The government has amended the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, notified under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, to tighten n.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The government has amended the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, notified under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, to tighten norms governing how online marketplaces display prices, search results and sponsored content, while imposing greater obligations on platforms over consumer complaints, data use and deceptive design practices.The Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2026 will come into force from January 1, 2027. The revised framework also seeks to strengthen disclosures around products and imported goods and curb charges for services unrelated to an e-commerce transaction.Key changesHere are the key changes as announced by the government:Discounts and price cuts: When a price reduction is announced, platforms must display both the reduced price and the “prior price”. The prior price will mean the lowest price at which the goods or services were offered in the 30 days before the discount was announced.Search results: E-commerce entities cannot manipulate search results in a way that misleads users or adversely affects the relevance of results to their search queries.Sponsored listings: Paid or sponsored listings must be identified through clear and prominent disclosures, making it easier for consumers to distinguish them from regular search results.Dark patterns: E-commerce entities will have to comply with the 2023 guidelines on prevention and regulation of dark patterns. They will also have to conduct a self-audit every year and prominently display a certificate of compliance.Consumer complaints: Every e-commerce entity must provide a complainant with a copy of the complaint as recorded by its grievance officer.Consumer helpline: Every e-commerce entity will have to become a partner in the convergence process of the National Consumer Helpline (NCH). The NCH received 17,71,622 grievances in 2025, with 5,11,196, or about 29 per cent, relating to the e-commerce sector.Product and seller information: Marketplace platforms will have to provide key information such as best before/use before dates, return and refund terms, warranty, delivery and payment details to help consumers make informed decisions.Imported goods: Details of the importer and the country of origin will have to be disclosed for imported products.Use of consumer data: Marketplace e-commerce entities cannot use consumer information for specified purposes without the consumer’s express and affirmative consent.Bundled fees: Platforms cannot collect bundled fees for services unrelated to the e-commerce platform, except under the specified provision for loyalty or membership programmes.Get the latest Business News and Live updates.
